measurement_limits: Debug simulator, synthetic fixed text and no production images; direct title uses synchronous test names, not the production account cache.
Sampling observes UIKit title/list hosts and presentation opacity, not actual text pixels or GPU compositing.
Navigation-bar layer animation probe observed no keyed animations; it cannot establish the production transition timing.
Initial construction delayed MainActor sampling in the first run; no stack trace attributes that delay to a particular function.
The reported physical-device blank header has not been reproduced by these probes.
confirmed_code_facts: Peer presentation lookup key is immutable and set in detail-store initialization.
Cached name is synchronously read in the header view body.
Custom principal toolbar and trailing menu are declared outside the loading/loaded switch.
The detail view replaces its Group content during loading/loaded changes.
Zoom transition is used by the image viewer, not the ordinary conversation destination.
findings: Title host was never sampled later than the collection host in these synthetic runs.
A loading-to-loaded content change alone does not establish the reported cause.
The prior suggestion of late toolbar attachment remains a hypothesis, not a demonstrated diagnosis.
next_isolation: Release physical-device trace of a real conversation entry: data-ready, title-content appearance, transition boundaries, main-thread stacks and rendered frames.
Compare native text navigation title and fixed-content principal title on the same device before changing navigation architecture.

sources.relation: First-person report of native navigation-bar first-render flicker; no confirmed resolution.
Custom large-title transition overlap; Apple requests a focused reproduction. Different toolbar placement from this app.
Search-indexed first-person iOS 26 beta report of title loss after loading/List state transitions; no direct thread URL recovered.
